mechanism: Full-universe (KR_ALL_LIQ2E8, ~1500-1850 names/month with 20d ADV>=2e8, t-1 PIT C10) risk-aware value composite. Economic rationale: cross-sectional value premium (cheap-on-fundamentals stocks earn risk/behavioral premium; Fama-French 1992/1993, Asness-Frazzini-Pedersen 2013) measured via an equal-weight composite of 6 PIT-safe value proxies (earnings, EBIT, EV/EBITDA, sales, EV/Sales, book yields), with a tail-risk tilt (R05_Tail_Risk) intended to lean toward names with milder downside tail exposure (defensive value, AX-001 v2 spirit). Composite avoids single-proxy fragility (KR EP_STANDALONE failure AX-003, L-132/135). The full-universe scope is the central claim of the lost Cycle 1~9 artifact: restricted KOSPI200/KOSDAQ150 value was reported negative post-2017, full-universe allegedly survived. THIS RE-DERIVATION DOES NOT REPRODUCE THAT SURVIVAL (see anchor_comparison + escalation).
